name: Type 16 Maneuver Combat Vehicle
protection: Steel hull with bolt-on armour, wheeled tank destroyer. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; frontal arc resists 12.7/14.5 mm; 7.62x54R damages optics, tyres/tracks and exposed gear, 12.7/14.5 mm penetrates side and rear; all launchers penetrate.
visual_notes: 8x8 wheeled tank destroyer with low hull, four evenly spaced axles
Angular turret with long 105 mm gun and muzzle brake, similar in shape to a scaled-down Type 10 turret
Smoke grenade banks on turret sides; C-130/air-transportable
Chassis reused for the Type 24 common tactical wheeled vehicle (30 mm IFV, 120 mm mortar, recce)
variants: Type 24 ICV (30 mm Mk44, on order)
